messages:
Priya Rao: Quick async check — I'm compiling a tiny rollup of where the cross-pillar OKR milestones landed this quarter. Please reply with one line: SHIPPED / SLIPPED / BLOCKED + owner action by EOD. I'll assemble for the exec note.

Jun Park: runtime v2 autoscaler — SHIPPED. Went to prod last night, latency SLOs holding.

Miguel Torres: model-onboarding pipeline — SLIPPED. Missing final eval gating; I need help from SRE to repro flaky infra test. @Samir can you take a look?

Samir Patel: @Miguel yep, I'll dig in. Quick note — I saw a failing test in ci/canary that looks like a transient DB timeout. Tentative next step: increase retry backoff and re-run.

Olivia Chen: embeddings cache layer — BLOCKED. Need storage quota increase for staging to validate eviction policy. @Ava any updates from infra quota ticket?

Ava Liu: @Olivia infra quota ticket (INC-4721) approved but staging rollout is manual. I can schedule a small window tomorrow AM. If you can scope the validation script I'll run it.

Miguel Torres: thanks @Samir — I'll paste the failing log in #eng-infra later. For now mark pipeline SLIPPED -> owner action: Miguel to repro + Samir to investigate by Thu EOD.

Priya Rao: noted. For the exec rollup I need a 1-sentence impact note per item. Example: "runtime v2 autoscaler: shipped — reduces p99 latency by 12% and lowers cost/req by 8%." Please add those when you can.

Samir Patel: copy — will add impact note after root cause.

Olivia Chen: impact note draft for cache: "blocked — staging quota preventing eviction validation; prevents confident rollout of cache-first policy, delaying 20% token-cost reduction."

Priya Rao: perfect. One more ask — any outstanding CRs tied to these milestones? Call them out now so we can prioritize reviews.

Jun Park: runtime v2 has one last CR from @Ava on minor logging cleanup, should be a quick review.

Ava Liu: reviewing now, hope to submit by lunchtime.

deploy-bot: production deploy: runtime-v2-autoscaler @ prod-cluster finished successfully (build 8782) :white_check_mark:

Priya Rao: thanks team. I'll stitch this into the exec note and ping owners if I need clarifications. If anything moves between now and EOD, drop a short update here (one line). :thumbsup:
